subject: The hidden slider you haven't touched yet
preview_text: 90% of users skip it — but it's the loudest, cleanest part of the app. See what you're missing.
body_paragraphs: You probably opened Loudify once, turned up the volume, and closed it. That's fine. But there's a slider you haven't touched, and it's not the volume one.

Most people never find the system-wide +200% boost control. It's hidden behind a single tap on the main screen. The one that makes your headphones go louder than the phone ever allowed, without the crackle. Commuters use it to hear dialogue over train noise. Gamers use it to catch footsteps in FPS games. Audiobook fans use it to hear every word over a dishwasher.

Here's the catch: it's not a generic boost. It's tuned for your headphones the moment they connect. AutoEQ recognizes your model and applies the right curve. So when you slide that hidden control, you're not just getting loud — you're getting clean loud. The kind that makes you think, 'Why didn't I try this earlier?'

Open Loudify now and tap the three dots next to the volume slider. Drag it all the way up. That's the +200% boost. Then play something you couldn't hear before. P.S. — if you want the full AutoEQ history and all presets, that's Premium. But the boost itself? It's free. One tap. Go.
cta_text: Open Loudify and tap the hidden slider
